excluded_exponentiation: Inherited quick_and_dirty proof dependencies; keep original attempts/costs.
rules: All runs use identical frozen controller bytes and the same per-case limits.
Reuse validated baseline bytes and frozen tests/observations.
Report actual source success count; do not relax proof or validation gates.
Prefer the original ten; use only the two named supplements when needed, under the recorded conditional rule.
Once five source cases are available, do not launch additional source searches merely to seek six.

conditional_representative_selection.selection_uses: source acceptance and category preference, never ranking by speedup magnitude
conditional_representative_selection.if_target_unmet: Report actual count and retain all evidence; never reclassify an unproved, rejected or unrealized source candidate as success.

reporting.representative_ten: Explicitly selected examples; selection count is not an unbiased source-success rate.
reporting.broader_twenty: Preserve all successes, failures and no-gain cases. The full twenty-case set is not yet complete.

selection_policy: Targeted representative cohort, selected using program categories and observed source-optimization applicability, with a target of at least five source-optimized cases. This is not an unbiased sample or an estimate of source-optimization success over the original corpus.
